decision.explanation: Two distinct documents (D1 and D2) provide conflicting formation years for the 24th Rifle Division. Document D1S3 states the division was formed on July 26, 1918, and later renamed in November 1918. Document D2S3 states the division was formed on January 1, 1920, and renamed in November 1920. Both claims are direct and unambiguous, and since they refer to potentially different historical iterations of the same unit name, both are retained as valid answers.
